cards.title: Raise o rise
cards.summary: Las dos significan «subir», pero raise necesita un objeto (alguien sube algo) y rise no (algo sube solo).
cards.form: raise + objeto (raise, raised, raised) · rise sin objeto (rise, rose, risen)
uses: Raise: levantar o aumentar algo (raise your hand, raise prices).
Rise: subir por sí mismo (prices rise, the sun rises).
Raise también es «criar» (raise children) y, como sustantivo, un aumento de sueldo (a raise).

pitfalls.wrong: Rise your hand if you know the answer.
pitfalls.right: Raise your hand if you know the answer.
pitfalls.why: Con objeto (your hand) se usa raise.

pitfalls.wrong: Prices have raised a lot this year.
pitfalls.right: Prices have risen a lot this year.

pitfalls.wrong: The sun raises in the east.
pitfalls.right: The sun rises in the east.
pitfalls.why: El sol sube solo, sin objeto: rises.
